videos.title: The retained improvement loop
script: Begin with a retained policy and world model.
The policy proposes actions. The model predicts their consequences.
A feasible candidate is selected for external feedback. Predictions and observations are recorded separately.
Feedback can support policy updates. Model adaptation also requires unreliability, sufficient data, and budget.
Component checks assess proposed versions. A pair check tests their combined decision behavior.
Only an accepted pair guides the next round.

videos.title: Four candidates, one execution
script: This toy repair illustrates the paper's four-candidate, one-execution design.
The coder stays fixed. Four patches are proposed before one is selected.
The world model predicts execution outcomes and ranks the candidates.
Only the selected patch is executed. Other patches have predictions, not observed outcomes.
The result becomes feedback. In the adaptive setting, eligible feedback can revise the predictor.
The predictor can change later rankings while the coder stays fixed.

cues.subtitle: This toy repair illustrates the paper's four-candidate, one-execution design.

videos.title: 四个候选，一次执行
script: 用一个示意修复案例，理解论文的四选一执行设计。
代码生成器固定。先提出四个补丁，再选择一个。
世界模型预测执行结果，并为候选排序。
只执行选中的补丁。其余补丁只有预测，没有实测结果。
执行结果形成反馈。适配配置可用合格反馈更新预测器。
生成器不变，预测器仍能改变下一轮排序。

videos.title: An update is not acceptance
script: An update attempt produces a candidate version, not an automatic replacement.
Suppose its component checks pass: the pieces meet their own acceptance criteria.
The assembled pair must still be checked under matched evaluation conditions.
Here the pair check fails. The full previous pair is retained for the next cycle.
Separately, too little feedback coverage means insufficient evidence, not a reliable model.
Separate three decisions: select, attempt an update, and accept the system.
